title: Research: nine-call minimum for dyadic ternary frames with arbitrary dirty registers
head: c5f5bef84f6648d5573f801c283e01a333ea5f89
body:
Three repeated dimension-three identity interchanges cannot be completed in eight paid calls using the 338 frames A = u v^T / 2 with nonzero ternary three-vectors, even with any finite restored dirty workspace. This package proves the scoped nine-call minimum and gives an alphabet-valid attaining word. It adds only research/bit-dyadic-ternary-catalyst/.

The determinant and target-coefficient conditions reduce every word of length at most eight, in any order and with repetitions, to eight seven-call multisets and 665 eight-call multisets. Coefficient rank excludes all but six; exact additive characters on each generated subgroup exclude the six for every register count. The characters are not asserted to extend to the divisible group M3(Q).

Evidence and replay:

- Two separately implemented exact enumerations agree: decomposition counts 8 / 473 / 1 / 24 and eight-call subset histogram 579 x 1, 80 x 2, 6 x 4.
- Primary formal matrix replay checks the nine-call construction, including restored dirty registers; eight corrupted-certificate controls fail. The independent checker reconstructs the characters, checks positional multiplicities a second way, and rejects two additional corruptions.
- Registered replay and source bindings pass on Windows / CPython 3.12.14, standard library only. Isolated optimized primary replay also passes from outside the repository.

```sh
python3.12 -X utf8 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-dyadic-ternary-catalyst
python3 -I -O -B research/bit-dyadic-ternary-catalyst/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/bit-dyadic-ternary-catalyst/independent.py
```

The independent checker deliberately refuses -O. Certificate SHA256: 6d6bf2c4d260bd76b85b20fcca59869142f23810db66984cc94b502c2c30b8b3.

Scope: a computer-assisted finite-alphabet theorem, not a lower bound for arbitrary rational frames or integer multiplication. The optimistic nine-call moment is 3^a, so this particular catalytic route cannot yield a positive saving. No new kappa, selected-frontier change, physical supplier admission, full selected cold replay, Lean formalization, or independent human review is claimed. Larger alphabets remain open.

Started from current main ddb4371c16a5a5de9e363afa8c0d6d7c27429e3c, priority revision 2, refined bit-new-register-model card.
